# ResonateAndFireNeuron

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neuron model with intrinsic oscillatory dynamics that fires when its membrane potential resonates with an input frequency. Serves as a fundamental building block for frequency-selective processing in neuromorphic hardware, enabling compact spectral feature extraction in iNEST nodes.
